Didn't like it.
May 2026 • Family
Everybody, hello! Were in this restaurant on the recommendation of the guide, left in total disappointment. I'll write more:
1. They ordered red, low-salt fish, refused immediately because the smell was terrible.
3. Pancakes also with red fish, same thing. The cheese was just interrupting the smell. We tried, same thing.
3. Borscht is not made on beetroot, but simply with tomato paste, eaten by at most a third of the children
4. Dumplings - yes, they did. Deliciously done. 
5. They ordered Greek salad, the cheese stinks awfully. We couldn't eat.
6. Pinacolada - nothing about it either, with vodka diluted coconut, I don't understand 
7. Beer - delicious 
Unfortunately, they were left in total disappointment , as they were going especially to this place for Russian cuisine and reviews. And the waiters brought in different checks several times, ended up paying, I don't recommend, much to the regret. Always picking out proven places on vacation, but here it's a nightmare...
